title: How to build *aura* without saying a word

head: Guys with aura
cells: Hold eye contact a second longer
Dress one level above the room

head: They also
cells: Remember your name and use it

label: WHAT KILLS IT
head: Needing everyone to like you
sub: Over-explaining, over-texting, over-agreeing. Drop all three.

label: TRY TODAY
head: Pause 2 seconds before you reply
sub: Silence reads as confidence. Rushing reads as nerves.
